number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits) with the nearest binary64; 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational. Deviations and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics, not references. SI units.
item: 5. Benchmark family, continuum (cantilever, propped cantilever, pinned-pinned, fixed-fixed)
planar: Each case is one bending plane (equivalently, the pipe is restrained out of that plane). A circular pipe free in three dimensions has exactly repeated bending pairs whose basis is arbitrary: applied mode by mode, per-mode contributions and SRSS are then basis dependent; under the adopted repeated-cluster rule (signed sum within the cluster first) every rule is basis invariant (beam_skew_and_pairs.json, repeated_pair).

section.premises: no insulation, no corrosion or mill allowance; I = pi(OD^4 - ID^4)/64 on the metal; mbar = metal + contents; ibar = rho_pipe I (contents excluded from rotary inertia, DEL-04-09 REQ-001); J = 2I, jbar = rho_pipe J

spectrum_use: FLAT for every realization; TWO_SEGMENT_L2 for L = 2 m and TWO_SEGMENT_L64 for L = 64 m; scale factor s = 1, damping ratio 0.05 (CQC)

quantities.w_tip_m / w_mid_m: displacement relative to the supports at the tip (C) or midspan, +y
quantities.F0_N, FL_N: reaction force the support applies to the pipe at x = 0 / x = L, +y
quantities.M0_Nm: reaction moment the support applies at x = 0, counterclockwise (conjugate to theta = dw/dx)
quantities.M_mid_Nm, M_quarter_Nm: internal bending moment EI w'' at x = L/2, L/4 (moment on the left part at the cut)
quantities.V_quarter_N, V_mid_N: internal shear at x = L/4, L/2: force on the left part at the cut, -(EI w''' + w^2 ibar w')

rules_not_in_scope: ABSSUM_not_in_scope and PAIRWISE10_not_in_scope are not in the scope today

cross_checks.what: closed-form integrals of W, W^2, W'^2 against Gauss-Legendre quadrature
per mode: F(0) + F(L) + Gamma mbar L int W = 0
per mode: moments about x = 0 of reactions, transverse and rotary inertia
per mode: total transverse reaction per unit S = -effective mass
Euler-Bernoulli roots: determinant route against the textbook frequency equations (cos cosh = -1, tan = tanh, cos cosh = 1)
pinned-pinned closed form against the determinant route (both models)
static coefficients against the textbook values qL^4/8EI, qL^4/192EI, 5qL^4/384EI, qL^4/384EI and the end reactions
each truncation's f_r leaves exactly n periodic continuum modes in both models
L = 64 m: rotary shift of modes 1-3 below 1e-6 in every span; L = 2 m: above 1e-6 in every span
